prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile web app composition, portrait 390×844, iPhone Safari viewport
Primary request: design option C for Russian app «Моя рецептурная — XYKA PRO», same committed «Рецептурная мастерская» world, but centered on a physical aroma wheel and a single-page workbench. The visitor must clearly select flavor direction and verbal strength, then tap «Подобрать» or «Случайный микс».
Structure in order: thin 18+ nicotine notice; asymmetrical masthead with title left and two utility icons right for «Полка» and «Избранное»; headline «Соберём чашу»; a dominant illustrated but fully UI-like circular aroma index with eight labeled wedges around a quiet center, selected wedge «Чайное» in plum, each wedge a touch target; directly below, a row of four rectangular word-only strength tags with «Средняя» active; a broad stamped action «Подобрать» crossed by a thin drafting line, small «Случайный микс» beside it; lower half begins a detailed recipe docket «Лавандовый чифир» with 3 ingredient bars 45/35/20, tiny gram equivalents, public label «Средняя», confidence «Высокая», and taste sequence start–middle–aftertaste.
Style/medium: premium realistic mobile UI mockup, aroma laboratory drafting sheet plus Russian recipe notebook; tactile, original and implementable with semantic HTML/CSS/SVG.
Color palette: warm parchment #F3EBDD, ink #25221F, plum #702F4D, raspberry #B94E6E, tea green #536B58, muted brass #B48A52.
Materials/textures: light paper tooth, fine drafting arcs, ink hatch, one wax-like origin stamp; restrained, readable.
Typography: condensed editorial display heading, readable system sans controls; Russian text exactly as provided where visible.
Text (verbatim where visible): «18+ · Содержит никотин», «МОЯ РЕЦЕПТУРНАЯ», «XYKA PRO», «Соберём чашу», «Десерт», «Тропики», «Ягоды», «Цитрус», «Чайное», «Напитки», «Цветы», «Необычное», «Лёгкая», «Средне-лёгкая», «Средняя», «Крепкая», «Подобрать», «Случайный микс», «Лавандовый чифир», «Высокая», «Старт», «Середина», «Послевкусие».
Composition/framing: phone screen only, straight-on edge-to-edge app, the aroma selector fills roughly half the first viewport, recipe detail starts below; no phone frame, hand, room or photographic scene.
Constraints: no numeric strength or /10 or strength slider; ingredient percentages are allowed; no alcohol, ice or mint; no product pack photos; no ratings; accessible contrast and large touch areas; the circular selector must read as an interactive control, not a decorative poster.
Avoid: generic dashboard/bento cards, ecommerce catalog, black luxury hookah look, neon, gradients, glassmorphism, tiny typography, horizontal overflow, poster-only illustration, watermark.
